findings.text: Provides a boot or module time walker over a table of return site relocations that decodes each target, reconciles trampoline sites, validates expected thunk linkage, and rewrites the site in place when replacement size matches.
Exposes single shot, incremental add, and batch commit operations for live code patching that queue requests and apply them together with cross CPU coordination.
Provides direct patch helpers that copy supplied bytes into kernel or module text through a temporary mapping, with a chunked variant that splits large ranges to respect mapping limits.
Offers a translator that redirects a call destination to its thunk trampoline when thunks are active and the target lies in core text, otherwise returning the original address unchanged.

Acts as a table driven sealing entry that visits each recorded address and neutralizes its branch termination marker, additionally neutralizing nearby control flow metadata when fine grained enforcement is enabled.

Replacement for a return site is chosen per address as either a near jump toward the shared return thunk or a lone return operation, with leftover bytes of the original decoded length filled by trap bytes, reporting how many bytes were produced.

Each table entry is resolved as base plus stored displacement and decoded in kernel mode, with near jump destinations derived from length plus encoded displacement, trampoline sites handed to the static call fixer, other sites required to point at the shared thunk, and patching gated on size equality.

A return site counts as a static call trampoline only when bytes past a fixed offset match a known pattern, with recognized sites converted to return form under the text lock and unrecognized sites left for normal return handling.

Conditional near branch recognition checks for a two byte lead where the first byte denotes an extended opcode escape and the upper nibble of the second denotes the conditional family, returning the second byte on success and zero otherwise.
Incremental queueing flushes the pending batch when the array is full or when a new address would break nondecreasing order relative to the last queued entry, with an empty queue considered ordered.
Queued patch locations store position as an offset from the kernel text base and reconstruct absolute address by adding that offset back, keeping the stored form compact.

Queued entries record decoded length, leading opcode and displacement, normalize extended conditional branches onto short forms, require trap padding after control flow operations up to requested size, require exact length match for other operations, and emulate known NOP sizes as zero displacement jumps while rejecting unknown shapes.

Call thunk eligibility requires membership in built in or module core ranges by base inclusive end exclusive comparison with protection for module lookup, and excludes a fixed denylist covering exception entries, switch and fork return paths, plus config dependent restart, tracer and relocation ranges.

Thunk installation builds a relocated template instance for the padding area preceding the target, returns that area unchanged if already installed, warns and aborts when the area lacks the required NOP pattern, and otherwise writes directly or through the locked poke path.

Branch marker probing reads fault tolerantly and treats faults as absent, exact matching compares against the generated marker value, sealing overwrites a verified marker with a poison value, and prefix sealing distinguishes fine grained mode from kernel CFI mode while other modes do nothing, with hash decode accepting only a move immediate family and poison writing zero.

Several build dependent alternates are empty no ops that leave return sites, retpolines, or sealing tables untouched, indicating the corresponding mitigation or enforcement is disabled in that configuration.

Mutation of trampolines, batch commits, direct pokes and call destination translation all require the central text mutex, asserted in batch commit, direct poke and translation paths and explicitly acquired around trampoline conversion.

Temporary mapping writes serialize through a page table lock with interrupts saved, use read protection of the initial address space when resolving vmalloc pages outside debugger context, and run lock free only from the debugger master with other CPUs stopped.

The queued patch record conceptually contains a relative address, total length, leading opcode, branch displacement, inline replacement bytes and saved original first byte, populated at queue time and consumed across patch phases.

Control flow mode selection is held in read only after init storage with three mutually exclusive compiled defaults for automatic, kernel CFI and off, plus debug and branch history injection flags, where only one default is active per build.

Batch commit moves from idle through trap insertion plus global sync, tail update plus conditional sync with performance notification, first byte replacement plus conditional sync, and finally reference drain with queue reset, with empty queues returning immediately and trap final opcodes skipping the last write.

Transformation first reclassifies jump or return sites carrying a conditional prefix into conditional form, then selects replacement bytes per kind with special emulations for calls, sleds, jumps, return choice and reconstructed branches, skips writes on identity, and chooses early direct poke during boot or module init versus single shot SMP poke otherwise.

Direct patching resolves one or two backing pages based on boundary crossing, maps them without the global bit into a reserved window, switches to a temporary address space, copies with sanitizer suppression, clears the window, restores prior space, flushes the window range, verifies plain copies, then restores interrupts and releases the lock, iterating in bounded chunks for large copies.

Boundary detection accounts for offset plus length exceeding a page, boot allocator phase and missing or non reserved pages trigger fatal stops, preallocated mapping slots are assumed present, and post copy mismatch for plain copies is treated as unrecoverable.

Trampoline probing avoids faults by checking whether inspected bytes stay within one page and confirming kernel text membership on crossing before comparing, while marker probing uses fault tolerant reads that report absence instead of faulting.

Unbounded queue growth and out of order insertion are prevented by flushing before overflow and before order violation, and the commit path yields the CPU to avoid soft lockup pressure when many sites are pending.

A six byte patch length denotes an extended conditional branch whose stored form drops the leading escape prefix and whose applied form restores it, with queue and commit paths translating consistently between representations.

Trap bytes serve both as padding to fill the gap between replacement size and original decoded size and as the transient first byte placeholder during SMP patching, left in place when the final opcode itself is a trap.
